source: Road text read in the SCNU 360 VR tour (.cache/vr cube faces; stations in scripts/perf/vr-stations.json) and on the NGII 2025 orthophoto sheet 34702020 (0.25 m chips, 6x upscale, north up)
note: One entry per painted text marking (one lane block). `ids`: the text candidates of markings.geojson / markings-extra.geojson that belong to it. `lines`: the block's lines as the approaching driver sees them, top line (farthest) first. `travelBearingDeg`: the direction of travel the text is written for (degrees from north, clockwise), where the VR view shows it. `lineHeightM` (a syllable's length along the road: the main-gate lines are 2.7 m on the photo), `widthM` (the gate-out-far blobs miss part of the paint: the width of its inbound twin, 5.5 m on the photo) `colour` (yellow in the VR view) and `axis: "blob"` (the four syllables stand side by side on the photo, each blob long along travel) fix what the blobs cannot. Every text marking not listed here is drawn as the most likely statute text for its size and logged as 추정 by stages/markingsRegular.mjs.
